programs.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programs.desc: If there is one coveted Italian destination that makes us all dream of balmy summer night in the mediterranean, that is the Amalfi coast.

programs.title: Italian Food Safari
programs.desc: Food Safari Italy goes to Fremantle to join the last sardine fisherman on the Western Australian coast, the charming Jim Mendolia who supplies the fresh fish market.

programs.title: David Rocco's Eating Dirty
programs.sub_title: Bowls, Brains And Gold Of The Sea
programs.desc: This time on Eating Dirty, David experiences the heavy carbs and crazy lunchtime antics in one of Naples' most famous restaurants.

programs.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programs.desc: Justine shows you how to crumb cutlets with parmesan and makes a delicious chia crusted salmon, while Colin Magee drops in to share his recipe for a sesame crusted tuna with a Japanese slaw.

programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: Adam welcomes recipe developer Lina Jebeile and chef Rashedul Hasan into the kitchen to make some fantastically fast, fresh and foolproof food.

programs.title: Locals Welcome
programs.desc: Suresh Doss explores Iranian food in Toronto and finds a cuisine with rich traditions of hospitality.

programs.title: Frugal Foodie
programs.desc: Perfect for busy weeknights, these speedy recipes deliver flavour and nutrition in just 15 minutes. Steph serves up San choi bow, Creamy Tuscan Salmon and a Black bean Nacho Soup.

programs.title: Great Chocolate Showdown
programs.desc: The remaining nine bakers must think beyond the bar as they create a nougat-filled chocolate confection in a surprising shape as they vie for the coveted Golden Whisk.

programs.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
programs.desc: Adam Liaw discovers and devours some of the finest miso, Nagoya chicken and Wagyu beef in Japan before meeting a 74-year-old who still free-dives for precious abalone.

programs.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programs.desc: Adam begins his culinary road trip in the northern tip of Western Australia, discovering food heroes who are putting community first, and the delights of mud crab and pearl meat.

programs.title: Kitchen Glow Up
programs.desc: Noelle, a designer at Hedley & Bennett & her husband Tim love to cook-but their small kitchen has killed the joy. With awkward cabinets, lost appliances & no space they need Ellen to bring order.

programs.title: On Country Kitchen
programs.desc: Mark and Derek learn about the overabundance of sea urchin, and explore a new type of sustainable farming in Berrima. The boys also have a go at bee keeping.
